scientific_limitations: The transverse trichotomy is linearized only; the nonlinear open blow-up tube requires \(c>1\) and sufficiently high initial z; no global basin or attractor exclusion is claimed. title: Open finite-time escape and a transverse pole trichotomy in a quadratic chameleon flow
